survey.question: What kind of story do you want more of?

items.title: Deadline deal: Chiefs acquire WR Josh Downs from the Colts for a 4th- and 5th-round pick, with a 7th-rounder coming back
items.subheader: The move fills KC's biggest need two days after Xavier Worthy's hamstring injury. Downs approved the deal with his first post on X since the summer; Mahomes answered with an alarm-clock image.

items.title: The fit: ESPN grades Downs the deadline's 'best environmental improvement' - from the Colts' 31st-ranked passing EPA to Andy Reid's screen-and-quick-pass machine
items.subheader: Indianapolis ranked 31st in EPA per dropback and last in explosive pass rate; the Chiefs sit 8th and 7th. Downs hits free agency after the season, so KC gets a motivated slot separator for Day 3 picks.

quotes.text: No team throws more screens and quick passes than the Chiefs, which will serve Downs' separation ability from the slot well.

items.title: The new depth chart: Rice, Downs and a healthy Worthy form the top tier; Royals' ankle injury is minor and Thornton stays on IR
items.subheader: Rashee Rice, Downs and Xavier Worthy (once his hamstring heals) lead the room; rookie Jalen Royals' ankle injury is not expected to be an extended absence. Tyquan Thornton remains on IR with a fractured ankle.

items.title: Mahomes' elbow MRI shows no major injury; Reid calls him day-to-day and 'in good spirits' with Atlanta up Sunday
items.subheader: Reid says all three of Mahomes (elbow), Worthy (hamstring) and Jaylon Moore (ankle) are day-to-day. Worthy's best case is a couple of weeks; the worst is an IR-return stint. Joshua Ezeudu would start at RT if Moore sits.
items.image_alt: Patrick Mahomes during the win over the Jets

quotes.text: It was more positive news than negative news on Patrick. It looks like it's just a matter of some rehab in there and getting rid of some of the soreness, and we'll just see where it goes from there. But he's in good spirits today.

items.title: Around the deadline: Cousins lands back in Minnesota, and the Bengals nearly spent a 3rd-round comp pick on Falcons edge Ebiketie before backing out after a cap analyst's tweet
items.subheader: ESPN's winners-and-losers column: Kirk Cousins reunites with the Vikings; Howie Roseman flipped Jordan Davis to the Jaguars for a 1st and a 2nd; the Titans stockpiled picks; the Chargers stood pat and lost.

items.title: Must-win at Rutgers: bowl eligibility on the line Saturday at 11:30 a.m. CT on BTN, with Nebraska a 13.5-point favorite
items.subheader: Rutgers (2-7) ranks 15th or worse in the Big Ten in all four major defensive categories. Nebraska has outgained every opponent this season - one of only four teams in the country to do it - but carries a four-game skid.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is GA: Google's strongest model hits the API at the same $2/$10 per-million-token price as Argon, claiming #1 on CursorBench 4.0 at 2x lower cost per task
items.subheader: Available to all paying developers in AI Studio and rolling out to AI Ultra subscribers. Google is also previewing /swarm in Antigravity: one prompt fans out to a coordinated team of named agents with adversarial verifiers.

quotes.text: Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows across complex knowledge work, software engineering, and scientific reasoning.

items.title: Claude gets Sheets, Whiteboards and Data artifacts, plus interactive connectors that embed Adobe and Atlassian apps inside the chat
items.subheader: Anthropic's new artifact types build spreadsheets, dashboards and idea boards without leaving Claude. Salesforce, NetSuite and Workday plugins (beta) ship with sales, finance and HR skills; Claude Meetings note-taking is next.

items.title: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT: claim your profile, feed it your catalog, and spin up a Business Agent that answers shoppers in chat
items.subheader: US e-commerce and online-service businesses can provide product feeds with pricing and availability and track customer engagement. The launch is in beta - another step toward agentic commerce inside ChatGPT.

items.title: Dependency alert: browser-use 1.0.2 pins pydantic-ai-slim==2.66.0 while pydantic-ai 2.67 demands 2.67.0 - the two will not install in the same environment
items.subheader: pydantic-ai 2.67 adds instruction files, durable sub-agents and operator authority; browser-use 1.0's persistent-REPL-on-CDP rewrite rides on it. AG2 1.3.1 and FastMCP 4.1.8 shipped in the same 48-hour window.
items.image_alt: AI Agents Info headline card for the browser-use / Pydantic AI pin conflict

items.title: The Marina Safeway towers won city approval Nov. 6 via AB 2011 - but a federal lawsuit filed in September could freeze construction until a February ruling
items.subheader: YesAND Foundation and Neighborhoods United SF allege documented toxic waste at 11 and 15 Marina Blvd. and say the city fast-tracked the 848-unit project. Align Real Estate says it has no timeline to break ground; a motion-to-dismiss ruling is expected in February 2027.
items.image_alt: Generated illustration of the proposed towers above the Marina Safeway

quotes.text: We appreciate the diligent work of city staff in moving this important project forward. This approval brings us one step closer to welcoming new families to a neighborhood that has seen far too little housing development, while delivering a modern grocery store for the entire community.

items.title: City report: one 50-megawatt data center would draw as much electricity as 25,000 homes - supervisors weigh extending SF's data-center moratorium another 10.5 months
items.subheader: SF's transmission capacity is about 1,000 MW against an 800 MW peak, and a new line could take a decade. The Lurie-commissioned report floats power caps, fees and 75-decibel generator limits but recommends nothing. Santa Clara, with 56 data centers, is weighing water restrictions.
items.image_alt: Generated illustration of a data center drawing power past San Francisco row houses

items.title: An Alaska Airlines pilot aborted her SFO landing Tuesday after spotting another plane crossing the runway - FAA and NTSB scrutiny expected
items.subheader: Flight 528's go-around drew comparisons to Air Canada's 2017 taxiway near-miss at SFO. Per FAA data, go-arounds happen in 1 to 3 of every 1,000 flights; SFO's parallel runways handle over 1,000 flights a day.

quotes.text: We thought the best course of action was the safest one, and we'll come back around and do it again.
quotes.by: Alaska Flight 528 pilot, over the cabin intercom

items.title: Overnight two-alarm fire gutted an abandoned warehouse at the Hunters Point naval shipyard, collapsing three-quarters of the building
items.subheader: SFFD was called around 3 a.m. to Manseau St. No one was inside, no injuries, and crews say the fire is about 80% contained with no threat to other buildings.
items.image_alt: Fire at the abandoned Hunters Point warehouse

quotes.text: There's no threat to any other buildings, and no one is injured at this time. It's not going to go any further, but there's still visible flames.
